localChecks.executionHost: Linux cloud workspace with official audited Windows bundle

checks: Official installer and native bundle checksums
Official codec, compatibility, preflight, coordinated restore and status tests on Windows
Actual IDE initializes its SQLite profile
Detached worker waits while the actual IDE is open
Normal IDE shutdown followed by native apply and status readback
IDE reopens and managed native preferences persist
Effective global and language editor settings through the actual IDE API
Actual TypeScript variable and symbol auto-import completions
Actual Python workspace override detected with exact source path

limitations: Authenticated Google chat, live model execution and model-generated suggestion UI are not tested.
The actual IDE harness directly exercises the production profile module; packaged helper activation and startup recovery have separate unit/build coverage.
Actual IDE smoke skips external gallery extensions, system font registration, browser provisioning and MCP network provisioning.
Native writes support only cataloged, checksum-verified Windows builds; the current catalog contains 2.5.5.
Project overrides are reported with source paths and remain effective until explicitly changed.
A coordinated restore can report partial completion if file IO fails after native restoration; it is not a cross-file/database atomic transaction.

reproduce.actualWindows: GitHub Actions: Native Windows IDE smoke; disposable GitHub-hosted Windows runner only

note: Records immutable tested source commits. A later report/documentation commit does not change the tested installer.
